# quartetplugin — Quartet

**Quartet** music (Atari ST / Amiga), the Microdeal sample sequencer.

A Quartet song references a `.set` instrument definition alongside the tune
itself. The `.set` files are **companion files, not songs** — they are listed in
`data/misc/not_supported_extensions.txt` so they never appear as index rows, and
are fetched automatically as secondary files when a tune plays.

UADE also carries Quartet / Quartet-PSG / Quartet-ST eagleplayers; see
[uadeplugin](../uadeplugin/README.md).
